nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the CI container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) used by the monorepo build, explaining their purpose and how the build script produces them.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Bun shell script that builds the five CI container images (base, bun-node, rust, tauri-linux, publish) via docker buildx for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, optionally pushing to a registry; derives the pinned Bun version from the root packageManager field.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun's `$` tagged-template shell API; the bun-node image version is sourced from the root package.json packageManager field to keep the container Bun in sync with the repo.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the containers package, extending the shared root config with package-specific compiler options for the container build scripts.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/core, the shared core package used by both opencode and app; declares the opencode bin, wildcard `./*` subpath exports, and dependencies on effect, zod, and platform libraries.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidance notes for the core package: explains that Effect Schema ASTs are immutable so the effect-zod walkCache stays valid, and that Effect.runSyncExit on async transforms surfaces as defects rather than silent errors.

nodes.name: cross-spawn-spawner.ts
nodes.summary: Implements Effect's CommandExecutor contract on top of cross-spawn, providing Effect-native child process spawning with stream/sink stdio bridging, process-group kill on timeout, and PlatformError mapping. Exports the make factory plus layer/defaultLayer for wiring into a runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges Effect Platform's Command/CommandInput abstractions onto node child_process: streams become 'pipe' stdio, timeouts kill the detached process group, and spawn errors are normalized to PlatformError via a tag-mapping helper.

nodes.name: effect-zod.ts
nodes.summary: Converts Effect Schemas to zod schemas by walking the Effect Schema AST, translating types, refinements, defaults, optionality, unions, and objects. The derived zod forms feed the zod-openapi JSON Schema pipeline used by the LLM/SDK layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Memoizes walks in a WeakMap keyed by AST node identity — safe because Effect Schema ASTs are immutable and shared. A ZodOverride symbol annotation lets authors hand-craft a zod schema that overrides AST-derived output.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Custom Effect Logger implementation that normalizes structured log fields (renaming sessionID to session.id), renders log spans as durations, and attaches causes, providing a Handle facade with debug/info/warn/error methods.

nodes.name: memo-map.ts
nodes.summary: Creates and exports a process-wide Layer memo map so independently built runtimes share memoized service instances instead of re-constructing layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Layer.makeMemoMapUnsafe is called once at module load; passing this shared MemoMap to ManagedRuntime.make is how services stay singletons across multiple runtimes.

nodes.name: observability.ts
nodes.summary: Wires OpenTelemetry observability when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set: builds the OTLP resource attributes, layers the OTLP log exporter alongside the custom Effect logger, and lazily initializes NodeSdk tracing via dynamic imports.
nodes.languageNotes: Trace SDK packages (@opentelemetry/sdk-node etc.) are loaded via dynamic import inside the layer so the tracing stack never loads unless OTel is enabled.

nodes.name: runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that builds a ManagedRuntime for a service layer (sharing the global memo map and observability layer) and returns a convenience facade exposing runSync, runPromise, runPromiseExit, runFork, and runCallback.

nodes.name: filesystem.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AppFileSystem service: an Effect FileSystem extension with safe exists/read helpers, JSON read/write, directory-creating writes, typed directory entries, glob support, and findUp/up/globUp ancestor searches. Also exports Windows-aware pure path helpers (normalizePath, windowsPath, resolve, overlaps, contains).
nodes.languageNotes: windowsPath rewrites POSIX-style drive prefixes (/c/, /cygdrive/c/, /mnt/c/) into Windows drive letters so paths coming from Git Bash, Cygwin, or WSL resolve correctly on win32.

nodes.name: flag.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes all environment-variable feature flags (OPENCODE_DISABLE_*, OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_*, OTEL endpoints) into a single Flag object, with channel-aware defaults so experimental features are on for dev/beta/local and opt-in for stable.
nodes.languageNotes: unstableDefault() flips defaults by InstallationChannel: flags like OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_MARKDOWN and OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CUSTOMIZE_SKILL default on unless the channel is stable.

nodes.name: global.ts
nodes.summary: Global paths service that resolves the opencode state/config/cache directories (honoring XDG conventions and the global lock system) and exposes them as a Context service with layer/defaultLayer/layerWith constructors.

nodes.name: version.ts
nodes.summary: Exports the installation version, channel, and an is-local boolean from compile-time defines, falling back to "local" when not built.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads global OPENCODE_VERSION/OPENCODE_CHANNEL constants that Bun's compile step injects as defines; typeof guards keep unbuilt dev runs from throwing on undefined globals.

nodes.name: npm-config.ts
nodes.summary: Loads resolved npm configuration for a directory via @npmcli/config (project, user, and global .npmrc) as an Effect, and derives the normalized registry URL used for package operations.

nodes.name: npm.ts
nodes.summary: Npm service that installs and manages packages programmatically through @npmcli/arborist (reify-based install/add), guarded by the EffectFlock cross-process lock, with bin resolution (which) and entry-point resolution for installed packages. Also exposes standalone install/add/which helpers backed by a default runtime.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Arborist.reify instead of shelling out to npm so installs respect the user's .npmrc without spawning a child process; concurrent installs on the same directory serialize through a file lock.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Reusable Effect Schema building blocks: PositiveInt/NonNegativeInt branded ints, optionalOmitUndefined for optional keys that skip undefined values, withStatics for attaching static methods to schemas, and a Newtype helper for zero-cost branded types.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent guidance for the core util directory covering the error.ts isInstance null guard, identifier.ts module-level mutable state caveat, and the fact that binary.ts insert mutates the array in place.

nodes.name: array.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a findLast helper that scans an array backwards for the last element matching a predicate.

nodes.name: binary.ts
nodes.summary: Binary search primitives over arrays sorted by a string key: search locates an id (returning found + insertion index) and insert splices a new item into sorted position, mutating the array in place.
nodes.languageNotes: insert mutates the caller's array via splice — a deliberate performance choice documented in util/AGENTS.md; callers wanting immutability must copy first.

nodes.name: effect-flock.ts
nodes.summary: Effect-native cross-process file locking service built on atomic mkdir: acquires advisory locks under the global state directory with heartbeat files, stale-lock takeover via a breaker directory, jittered retry with timeout, and scope-based automatic release. Exposes acquire and withLock through a Context service.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses mkdir EEXIST as the atomic contention primitive (works on POSIX and Windows without O_EXCL races); a .breaker directory arbitrates which waiter may reclaim a stale lock, and Effect.ensuring guarantees breaker cleanup.

nodes.name: encode.ts
nodes.summary: Encoding and hashing helpers: URL-safe base64 encode/decode, async SHA hashing via WebCrypto, a fast FNV-style string checksum, and sampledChecksum which fingerprints large content by checksumming evenly spaced windows.

nodes.name: error.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the NamedError base class: a Schema.TaggedErrorClass factory that gives every error a tagged zod schema (name + data), a toObject serializer, an isInstance null-safe type guard, and a create constructor for subclassing.
nodes.languageNotes: isInstance deliberately accepts null/undefined (returning false) because deserialized errors may be missing; Object.defineProperty pins the class name so tagged schemas survive minification.

nodes.name: flock.ts
nodes.summary: Promise-based cross-process file locking (the non-Effect twin of effect-flock): atomic-mkdir lock directories with heartbeat mtime updates, stale detection and breaker-coordinated takeover, jittered retry with timeout and abort support, plus acquire/withLock/async-dispose lease APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Heartbeats touch the lock directory's mtime via utimes on an unref'd interval, so a crashed holder's lock goes stale after staleMs and a surviving waiter reclaims it through the .breaker race.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Builds the CommandExecutor service: resolves cwd/env, maps Effect streams and sinks onto 'pipe' stdio, spawns via cross-spawn with detached process groups, wires stdin/stdout/stderr streams, implements signal sending with group-kill fallback, and applies timeouts.

nodes.name: zod
nodes.summary: Converts any Effect Schema into the equivalent zod type by walking the schema's AST, returning the memoized cached subtree when available.

nodes.name: zodObject
nodes.summary: Like zod() but narrows the result to z.ZodObject so .shape/.omit/.extend are usable; honors a schema's pre-attached .zod static or the ZodOverride annotation instead of re-deriving from the AST.

nodes.name: toJsonSchema
nodes.summary: Emits a JSON Schema from an Effect Schema by deriving the zod form first, so Effect Schema tool/route parameters flow through the same zod-openapi pipeline as native zod schemas (io: "input").

nodes.name: translateFilter
nodes.summary: Translates a single Effect Schema AST filter annotation into the corresponding zod constraint (min/max/length/startsWith/regex/integers/etc.), returning unhandled filters so the caller can fall back to superRefine.

nodes.name: logger
nodes.summary: The core Logger.make implementation: reads fiber log annotations and spans, converts span durations to milliseconds, pretty-prints causes, and forwards each entry to the shared Log sink with normalized field keys.

nodes.name: resource
nodes.summary: Builds the OTLP resource descriptor (service name/version plus attributes) by merging process metadata with OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES parsed from the W3C comma-separated key=value format.

nodes.name: logs
nodes.summary: Constructs the logging layer that replaces existing loggers with the custom Effect logger plus an OTLP HTTP log exporter pointed at the configured collector endpoint.

nodes.name: traces
nodes.summary: Lazily imports the OpenTelemetry Node SDK and builds a tracing layer that installs a global context manager, enables instrumentation, and exports spans to the OTLP endpoint.

nodes.name: makeRuntime
nodes.summary: Creates a ManagedRuntime for a service tag and layer (memoized via the shared memo map and observability layer) and returns a facade with runSync/runPromise/runPromiseExit/runFork/runCallback helpers.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Constructs the AppFileSystem service over Effect's FileSystem: safe exists/read variants that swallow NotFound, JSON read/write, ensureDir, writeWithDirs that creates parent directories on demand, typed directory entries, glob delegation, and findUp/up/globUp ancestor walkers.

nodes.name: findUp
nodes.summary: Walks ancestor directories from a start path collecting every occurrence of a named target file, stopping at an optional boundary or the filesystem root.

nodes.name: normalizePath
nodes.summary: Normalizes a path for Windows by converting POSIX drive prefixes, resolving, and following the native realpath (falling back to the resolved path when the target does not exist).

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a path to its real absolute form on Windows (handling WSL/cygdrive prefixes and symlinks), returning the normalized resolved path for missing targets instead of throwing on ENOENT.

nodes.name: windowsPath
nodes.summary: Rewrites Git Bash (/c/), Cygwin (/cygdrive/c/), and WSL (/mnt/c/) drive prefixes into uppercase Windows drive-letter paths; a no-op on non-win32 platforms.

nodes.name: make
nodes.summary: Computes the global paths object (config, state, cache directories) from the home directory and XDG-style environment overrides, seeding the Flock global so locks land under the state directory.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads the fully resolved npm configuration for a directory using @npmcli/config (merging project/user/global .npmrc and defaults) as an Effect, falling back to an empty config on failure.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Builds the Npm service: directory-scoped installs guarded by an EffectFlock lock, Arborist-based reify for install/add with parsed npm config, bin discovery via which-like resolution, and entry-point lookup through import.meta.resolve.

nodes.name: resolveEntryPoint
nodes.summary: Resolves a package's main entry point file using import.meta.resolve against the consuming module, returning an Option of the resolved path.

nodes.name: Newtype
nodes.summary: Creates a zero-cost branded newtype over a Schema: values are branded via prototype at decode time, giving nominal typing (SessionID vs plain string) without runtime overhead.

nodes.name: optionalOmitUndefined
nodes.summary: Wraps a Schema as an optional key whose encoding skips undefined values entirely, and whose derived zod form is optional — avoiding explicit undefined leaking into serialized output.

nodes.name: findLast
nodes.summary: Scans an array from the end and returns the last element satisfying the predicate, or undefined.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Binary-searches a string-sorted array for an id, returning whether it was found along with the insertion index for the miss case.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts an item into a string-sorted array at its binary-searched position, splicing in place and returning the same (mutated) array.

nodes.name: layer
nodes.summary: Builds the EffectFlock service over Global and AppFileSystem: implements acquire via atomic-mkdir lock directories with stale-breaker takeover and a jittered exponential retry schedule, and withLock as a scoped acquire/release wrapper.

nodes.name: tryAcquireLockDir
nodes.summary: Single attempt at acquiring a lock directory: claims it atomically via exclusive mkdir; on contention checks staleness, races a .breaker directory to decide which waiter may remove and recreate the stale lock, then writes heartbeat and meta.json exclusively.

nodes.name: checksum
nodes.summary: Computes a fast synchronous FNV-style 32-bit rolling hash of a string as a compact decimal checksum.

nodes.name: sampledChecksum
nodes.summary: Fingerprints arbitrarily large content by checksumming evenly spaced sample windows of bounded size, joining the per-window checksums into one stable content signature.

nodes.name: NamedError
nodes.summary: Base class for all typed errors in the codebase: create() derives a Schema.TaggedErrorClass with a name-literal + data schema, plus toObject serialization, a null-safe isInstance guard, and message formatting from the data payload.

nodes.name: acquire
nodes.summary: Acquires a cross-process lock for a key: hashes the key into a lock directory under the global state root, retries with jitter until timeout, starts the heartbeat, and returns a Lease with release and Symbol.asyncDispose.

nodes.name: tryAcquireLockDir
nodes.summary: One lock-acquisition attempt: atomically mkdir's the lock dir; if contended, detects staleness from heartbeat age, uses a .breaker directory to elect a single waiter to reclaim the stale lock, then writes heartbeat and meta.json with exclusive-create flags.
